name: pack-t-1000
comment: Fable's profile T, tiny/idle (streams-cost report 2026-10-24, section 4.1), 1,000 projects on one launch cell (the packing measurement, README 'Packing'): each project 3 streams, 200 appends a day of 400 B JSON singles (open-loop Poisson, 0.0023 a second over its 3 streams) and one long-poll tail on its first stream, always connected (one parked wait). Setup 0-120 s, the load 180-1,640 s (projects start spread over 60 s; writers stop 20 s or more before the readers), the verdict window 'steady' 360-1,560 s (20 min). The class pool holds every project's wait at once.
